entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
entry.summary:
At 04:37 pm, MetService weather radar detected severe thunderstorms near OFFSHORE RAKAIA RIVER MOUTH, SEAFIELD and PENDARVES.
These severe thunderstorms are moving towards the eastnortheast, and are expected to lie near SOUTHBRIDGE, LEESTON, OFFSHORE SOUTH OF BANKS PENINSULA, OFFSHORE RAKAIA RIVER MOUTH and RAKAIA HUTS at 05:07 pm and near OFFSHORE SOUTH OF BANKS PENINSULA, LAKE ELLESMERE and BIRDLINGS FLAT at 05:37 pm.
These thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by large hail.
Impact:
Large hail can cause significant damage to crops, orchards, vines, glasshouses and vehicles, and make driving conditions hazardous.

entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch
entry.summary: Cold temperatures at upper levels and daytime heating are bringing unstable conditions to Canterbury, especially Christchurch City, the Banks Peninsula and coastal areas just south of it. Thunderstorms are likely this afternoon and into this evening. They could be Severe and accompanied by large damaging hail, larger than 20mm diameter. Large hail can cause significant damage to crops, orchards, vines, glasshouses and vehicles, as well as make driving conditions hazardous.
